description: Credit forecast (docs/requirements.md 3.1; engine/ChangeRadar.Credits.psm1 Get-CreditForecast). Written before the engine function. Cases 01 to 03 are the worked examples in requirements.md, so the doc and setup/Get-CreditEstimate.ps1 agree. Each prompt stage is capped separately at cap x 30 calls a month (0 = no cap). Monthly: fingerprint 30 x daily, rating 30 x daily x windowShare, assessment 30 x exposed x reassessShare. Backlog: fingerprint signals, rating toRate, assessment toAssess (before an install, toAssess = exposed; after, the exposed signals not yet assessed). Peak = backlog + a month, each stage capped. Nights to clear the fingerprint backlog = ceiling(signals / (fingerprint cap - daily)); null when the cap leaves no room for it or there is no cap and no backlog. Catch-up (finding 14): for the first catchupNights nights each cap is raised to catchupCap (never lowered; 0 stays no cap), so a stage's first-month limit is catchupCap x catchupNights + cap x (30 - catchupNights), and nights to clear count catch-up nights at (catchupCap - daily) first. firstMonthCeilingCalls is the sum of those limits. Without catch-up inputs, there is none. Each stage's calls and every credit figure are rounded to the nearest whole number, halves away from zero.

cases.note: requirements.md worked example: Large (all feeds, rating_scope all, so toRate = signals and windowShare = 1); the assessment cap holds a month, and every stage is capped in the peak month
no caps: nothing is held down and there is no ceiling; the backlog clears in the first night
new changes fill the fingerprint cap, so the backlog never clears
an installed environment with its backlog already cleared
Small with catch-up (finding 14): 100 a night for the first 14 nights. Same total calls; the backlog clears in 5 nights instead of 30; the first month's ceiling rises to 100 x 3 x 14 + 25 x 3 x 16
Large with catch-up: nothing is held down in the peak month, so it costs the full 3,480 calls, and the backlog clears in 7 nights instead of 54
catch-up ends before the backlog: 2 nights clear 180, the other 270 take 18 more at the normal cap
a catch-up cap below the normal cap is ignored (it never lowers a cap)
